# Boxtown

> Boxtown maps a product as nested boxes on a canvas: areas, pages, assemblies and components, with Markdown context, metadata and images on each box. The `boxtown` CLI reads and writes the same data, so coding agents can find work, read scoped context and report results.

Install: `npm install -g boxtown` (Node 22+). Start the viewer: `boxtown viewer` (data in `./boxtown/data`).

## Agent loop

- Install the bundled skill: `boxtown skill install --agent codex --global`
- Discover the schema first: `boxtown project schema --local ./boxtown/data --project <id> --json`
- Find work: `boxtown node list --status working --compact --local ./boxtown/data --project <id>`
- Read one scope with its parent chain: `boxtown node export-context <node-id> --local ./boxtown/data --project <id>`
- Write back: `boxtown node complete <node-id> --note "..."` and `boxtown image add <node-id> ./shot.png`
- Avoid `boxtown project view --json` for scoped work; it returns the whole graph.
- `--local <folder>` works for project, node and image commands and needs `--project <id>`. Remote servers use `--server` and `--token`.

## Data

Each project is a folder: `project.json`, `nodes/<node-id>.md` (YAML front matter plus Markdown context), `history/`, `images/`. The layout merges cleanly with git.
